items.title_en: Playa Phone
items.title_zh: Playa Phone：隐私优先智能手机
items.summary_en: Playa Phone is a privacy-focused smartphone project aiming to offer secure, open-source software with minimal data collection. It targets users who want more control over their data, featuring on-device processing and transparent permissions.
items.summary_zh: Playa Phone 是一个注重隐私的智能手机项目，致力于提供安全的开源软件与极小的数据收集。该计划面向希望提升数据控制权的用户，强调本地处理与透明权限。

items.title_en: I turned my security cameras into an automatic bird identification system
items.title_zh: 我把安防摄像头变成自动鸟类识别系统
items.summary_en: A DIY project repurposes home security cameras to feed BirdNET-Go for automatic bird identification. The approach shows how consumer hardware can enable wildlife monitoring at scale, with low cost and ease of deployment.
items.summary_zh: 一个 DIY 项目将家用安防摄像头接入 BirdNET-Go，实现自动鸟类识别。此做法展示了消费级硬件在野生生物监测中的可扩展性和低成本潜力。

items.title_en: OpenShot 4.0 – Open-source video editor
items.title_zh: OpenShot 4.0：开源视频编辑器
items.summary_en: OpenShot 4.0 introduces major UI and performance improvements, with enhanced recording, editing, and color tools. The update strengthens OpenShot as a beginner-friendly, cross-platform editor and demonstrates sustained, community-driven development in open-source video tools.
items.summary_zh: OpenShot 4.0 在界面与性能方面带来显著改进，新增录制、编辑和色彩工具。此次更新巩固了它作为面向初学者、跨平台的编辑器的定位，同时体现了开源视频工具领域的社区驱动持续发展。

items.title_en: “I just chose words carefully”
items.title_zh: 我只是认真地挑选了措辞
items.summary_en: Careful word choice shapes how tech ideas are understood and trusted, influencing user perception and accountability.
items.summary_zh: 在科技语境中，措辞的慎密选择决定了人们对技术理念的理解和信任度，影响公众感知与问责。

items.title_en: ChatGPT Work Tool and Skill Reference
items.title_zh: ChatGPT 工作工具与技能参考
items.summary_en: A practical reference mapping common work tasks to prompts, tools, and workflows for ChatGPT, helping teams embed AI into daily productivity. It highlights useful patterns, prompts, and caveats for reliable, repeatable results.
items.summary_zh: 这份实用参考把常见工作任务映射到 ChatGPT 的提示、工具与工作流程，帮助团队将人工智能融入日常生产力。内容包含有用的模式、提示集合以及可依赖的使用注意事项。

items.title_en: Breaking Claude Code Opus 5 Auto Mode
items.title_zh: 揭秘 Claude Code Opus 5 的自动模式
items.summary_en: A detailed look at Claude Code Opus 5 Auto Mode reveals how automation is integrated into coding tasks, where it shines and where it trips up. The piece argues for stronger guardrails and better transparency as AI copilots scale.
items.summary_zh: 对 Claude Code Opus 5 的自动模式进行了深度解剖，展示了自动化在编码任务中的应用，以及优点与局限。作者呼吁在 AI 助手规模化时加强安全控制与透明度。

items.title_en: A CVE Dispute
items.title_zh: 一个 CVE 的争议
items.summary_en: CVE dispute article examines a disagreement over vulnerability naming or assignment, highlighting how the CVE process handles ambiguity. It underscores how naming affects incident response and accountability.
items.summary_zh: 关于一个 CVE 的争议，分析对漏洞命名或分配的分歧，以及 CVE 体系如何处理歧义，强调命名对响应和问责的影响。

items.title_en: A 12TB Steam “teraleak” spills more than a decade of lost PC gaming history
items.title_zh: Steam 12TB 泄露：揭示逾十年的 PC 游戏历史
items.summary_en: A 12TB teraleak from Steam dumps unreleased builds, archived content, and long-lost projects, offering a trove of material for historians and archivists. It raises questions about digital preservation, licensing, and platform governance.
items.summary_zh: Steam 泄露数据库达12TB，包含未发行版本、档案材料与多年的流失项目，为历史学者和档案工作者提供宝贵素材，同时引发数字保存、许可与平台治理方面的讨论。

items.title_en: Apple caught off guard by AI demand for Mac Mini and Mac Studio
items.title_zh: 苹果被 AI 需求冲击 Mac Mini 与 Mac Studio
items.summary_en: Apple reportedly faces unexpected demand for AI workloads pushing Mac Mini and Mac Studio beyond forecasted capacity, prompting questions about hardware supply and Apple's AI strategy.
items.summary_zh: 报道称 AI 需求意外拉升对 Mac Mini 与 Mac Studio 的需求，超过了公司预期，暴露出硬件供应与 AI 策略之间的紧张关系。文章讨论了消费级硬件在 AI 场景中的应用及对供应与定价的潜在影响。

items.title_en: Agent memory as a file format
items.title_zh: 将 Agent Memory 作为一种文件格式
items.summary_en: The post proposes storing agent memory as a portable file format to persist state across sessions and enable sharing. It weighs tradeoffs around privacy, security, versioning, and interoperability with existing AI runtimes.
items.summary_zh: 提出将代理内存作为可移植的文件格式以跨会话持久化状态并实现共享，讨论隐私、安全、版本控制及与现有 AI 运行时的互操作性等取舍。

items.title_en: I think the military commissary's freezers were hacked
items.title_zh: 军事供应处冷冻库疑似被黑客入侵
items.summary_en: Suggests the military commissary freezers were hacked, illustrating how everyday infrastructure can be a security choke point. The piece advocates stronger supply-chain and facility security measures.
items.summary_zh: 质疑军事供应处冷冻库被黑客入侵的说法，凸显日常基础设施也可能成为安全薄弱点。文章呼吁加强供应链与设施安全措施。

items.title_en: uv: Deduplicate all files in the wheel cache
items.title_zh: uv：对 wheel 缓存中的所有文件进行去重
items.summary_en: A PR proposes deduplicating all files in Python's wheel cache, saving disk space and reducing redundancy. The change helps environments with large dependency trees run more predictably.
items.summary_zh: 提交的 PR 提案对 wheel 缓存中的所有文件进行去重，节省磁盘空间、减少冗余。此举有助于大依赖环境下的可预测性与稳定性。

items.title_en: Understanding ChatGPT Work
items.title_zh: 理解 ChatGPT 的工作原理
items.summary_en: Explains the fundamentals of how prompts are processed, how completions are generated, and what drives latency and cost in ChatGPT. It translates complex AI workloads into practical takeaways for developers designing prompts and managing budgets.
items.summary_zh: 讲解了 ChatGPT 如何处理提示、生成回答，以及推理成本和延迟的驱动因素。把复杂的 AI 负载转化为对开发者在设计提示和控成本时的实用要点。

items.title_en: ReactOS 0.4.16
items.title_zh: ReactOS 0.4.16 发布
items.summary_en: ReactOS 0.4.16 released, continuing effort to create a Windows-compatible open-source OS. The update likely includes bug fixes and minor features, reflecting the project's steady, long-running effort.
items.summary_zh: ReactOS 0.4.16 发布，继续推进打造与 Windows 兼容的开源操作系统的长期项目。

items.title_en: Omarchy: Any User Process Can Escalate to Root
items.title_zh: Omarchy：任意用户进程可升级为 root
items.summary_en: A vulnerability called Omarchy lets any user process escalate to root, effectively breaking privilege isolation. The issue underscores how fragile privilege boundaries can be and emphasizes the need for rapid patches, safer defaults, and stronger containment.
items.summary_zh: 名为 Omarchy 的漏洞允许任意用户进程提权到 root，从而破坏权限隔离。问题凸显了权限边界的脆弱性，强调需要迅速修补、采用更安全的默认设置，并加强对进程的容器化或沙箱保护。

items.title_en: P99 0 ms* autocomplete for 240M domain names
items.title_zh: P99 0 ms 自動完成覆蓋 2.4 億域名
items.summary_en: A fast autocomplete engine claims near-zero latency for a catalog of 240 million domain names, leveraging highly optimized in-memory indexing and prefix search. It demonstrates that with careful data structures and hardware-friendly techniques you can deliver instant suggestions at scale, which matters for domain search UX and registrars.
items.summary_zh: 在2.4億域名的海量列表上實現近乎0毫秒的自動完成，依賴高效的內存索引與前綴搜索。這顯示了透過精心的數據結構與硬件友好優化，仍能在大規模目錄上提供即時建議，對域名搜索和註冊等場景尤為重要。

items.title_en: European Commission Revives Push for Encryption Backdoors in ProtectEU Strategy
items.title_zh: 欧盟重新推动 ProtectEU 策略中的加密后门
items.summary_en: EU's ProtectEU revives calls for encryption backdoors to aid law enforcement, reigniting a broader debate on security vs. privacy. The piece outlines potential risks to security, freedom of expression, and the viability of secure communications if backdoors are mandated.
items.summary_zh: 欧盟在 ProtectEU 框架下重新推动对称/端对端加密的后门需求，引发关于安全与隐私的激烈辩论。若被强制实施，会对通信隐私与安全性造成长期风险，同时可能削弱整体系统的安全性。

items.title_en: California lawmakers unanimously pass Linux exemption from age-verification law
items.title_zh: 加州通过 Linux 豁免年龄验证法
items.summary_en: California lawmakers unanimously exempt Linux and GPL-licensed software from the state's age-verification requirement, preserving open-source distribution channels. The move clarifies that common open-source licenses shield software from age checks while still applying to other content.
items.summary_zh: 加州立法者一致通过针对 Linux 与 GPL 等开源软件的年龄验证豁免，确保开源软件的分发不受额外年龄要求限制。这一举措澄清了在某些内容需要年龄验证时，开源许可的软件不受这些限制。

items.title_en: Haiku R1/beta6 has been released
items.title_zh: Haiku R1/beta6 已发布
items.summary_en: Haiku OS releases R1/beta6, marking another step toward a stable, BeOS-inspired operating system. The beta focuses on hardware compatibility, performance improvements, and developer tooling as the community works toward a more complete 1.0.
items.summary_zh: Haiku OS 发布了 R1 的 beta6 版，向着稳定版又迈进一步。该版本在提升硬件兼容性、性能改进和开发工具方面做出努力，社区期待更完整的 1.0。

items.title_en: Transfer files over an Ethernet patch cable
items.title_zh: 通过以太网跳线直接传输文件
items.summary_en: Shows how to transfer files directly between machines using a regular Ethernet patch cable, bypassing switches and Wi‑Fi. It highlights simple, DIY networking possibilities, the need for a tiny transfer protocol, and the practical limits of speed and distance.
items.summary_zh: 演示如何通过普通以太网跳线在两台设备之间直接传输文件，省去交换机与无线路由等中介。展示了简易的DIY网络方案、所需的最小传输协议，以及速度与距离的现实限制。

items.title_en: OpenClaw 2.0, Accidentally
items.title_zh: OpenClaw 2.0：意外发布
items.summary_en: Reports an unintended release of OpenClaw 2.0, highlighting risks around releasing powerful tooling and the need for governance, safety checks, and responsible disclosure in AI tooling.
items.summary_zh: 报道 OpenClaw 2.0 的意外发布，强调公开强大工具带来的风险以及在 AI 工具方面需要的治理、安全检查和负责任披露。

items.title_en: Europe's summer drought is so extreme that desertification is a growing threat
items.title_zh: 欧洲夏季干旱极端化，沙漠化风险上升
items.summary_en: Europe's summer drought reached extreme levels, stressing rivers, crops, and ecosystems and raising desertification risks across the continent.
items.summary_zh: 欧洲夏季干旱达到极端水平，威胁河流、农作物和生态系统并提升沙漠化风险。报道聚焦气候影响、水资源管理挑战以及政策应对。

items.title_en: Matrox: Graphics for Professionals
items.title_zh: Matrox：面向专业用户的显卡解决方案
items.summary_en: Profiles Matrox’s graphics hardware tailored for professionals, emphasizing reliability, multiple-monitor setups, and niche workloads like CAD and video walls. It contrasts with mainstream GPUs and explains where Matrox fits in pro pipelines.
items.summary_zh: 概述 Matrox 针对专业用户的图形硬件，强调稳定性、多显示器支持及 CAD/视频墙等专用应用场景，与主流显卡形成区分，并说明在专业工作流中的定位。

items.title_en: How to build a diffusion language model
items.title_zh: 如何构建扩散式语言模型
items.summary_en: Presents an approach to building diffusion-based language models, covering data prep, model architecture, training, and sampling. Useful for researchers exploring non-autoregressive generative approaches.
items.summary_zh: 介绍了构建扩散式语言模型的思路，包括数据准备、模型结构、训练和采样等要点，适用于探索非自回归生成方法的研究者。

items.title_en: Hacking IKEA Furniture
items.title_zh: 改装 IKEA 家具
items.summary_en: A DIY guide shows how to hack Ikea furniture to add electronics or customization. It demonstrates affordable, modular DIY that can extend the life and utility of everyday furniture.
items.summary_zh: 这是一份关于如何改装 Ikea 家具以加入电子元件或自定义功能的动手指南，展示了低成本、模块化的 DIY 思路，能延长日常家具的使用价值。

items.title_en: Brits would quite like their private messages to stay private
items.title_zh: 英国人希望私信保持私密
items.summary_en: Poll results suggest Brits want stronger privacy protections for private messages, reflecting concerns about law-enforcement access and metadata. The discussion hints at potential political pressure for messaging-app privacy features.
items.summary_zh: 民意调查显示英国人希望私密消息获得更强保护，反映对执法访问和元数据的担忧。讨论暗示可能推动在消息应用隐私功能上的政治压力。

items.title_en: No AI Fridays
items.title_zh: No AI Fridays：周五禁用人工智能
items.summary_en: A movement encouraging teams to pause AI usage on Fridays to reflect on the impact of automation and data practices. It promotes thoughtful, ethical AI adoption and sparks conversations about governance and resilience.
items.summary_zh: 一个倡议，鼓励团队在周五暂停使用人工智能，以反思自动化与数据使用的影响。推动更负责任、伦理的 AI 采用，并引发治理与韧性方面的讨论。

items.title_en: METR and Redwood Offer Holy %^ Postmortem of the HuggingFace Hack
items.title_zh: METR 与 Redwood 提供 HuggingFace 黑客事件的事后分析
items.summary_en: The postmortem from Metr and Redwood details how a security incident at HuggingFace unfolded, outlining attack chain, misconfigurations, and remediation steps. It offers concrete lessons for securing open-source ML platforms and dependency supply chains.
items.summary_zh: METR 与 Redwood 的事后分析揭示 HuggingFace 安全事件的演变、攻击链与修复要点，并提出针对开源 ML 平台与依赖链的具体安全教训。

items.title_en: Lawmakers added $1 to car insurance policies. That money paid for Flock cameras
items.title_zh: 立法者在车险中多收1美元，用于资助Flock摄像头
items.summary_en: A modest insurance surcharge earmarked to fund Flock cameras reveals how state policy links private pricing with public surveillance infrastructure.
items.summary_zh: 一笔用于资助 Flock 摄像头的车险附加费反映出政府将私人定价与公共监控基础设施连结的做法。文章讨论公共安全资金与消费者成本之间的权衡。

items.title_en: Bug Blindness
items.title_zh: 漏洞盲点
items.summary_en: A deep dive into why developers consistently miss bugs, even in well-tested code, due to cognitive biases and organizational blind spots. The piece argues for stronger testability, structured debugging workflows, and diverse perspectives to counteract bug blindness.
items.summary_zh: 本文剖析开发者在经过多轮测试后仍漏掉缺陷的原因，源于认知偏差和组织层面的盲点。通过强调可测试性、结构化调试流程和多样化视角来对抗漏洞盲点。

items.title_en: Startup Anti-Patterns
items.title_zh: 初创企业的反模式
items.summary_en: A primer on startup anti-patterns that trap early-stage teams—from vanity metrics to misaligned incentives. The series encourages teams to focus on sustainable product-market fit, clear milestones, and customer feedback.
items.summary_zh: 简要介绍初创企业常见的反模式：从虚荣指标到目标错位等。系列内容鼓励团队聚焦可持续的产品-市场匹配、明确的里程碑和用户反馈。

items.title_en: The internet is kind of a predatory cesspit now
items.title_zh: 互联网如今有点成了掠夺性的泥潭
items.summary_en: Online spaces have devolved into predatory environments driven by monetization, harassment, and surveillance. The piece argues for stronger platform responsibility and safer design to curb these dynamics.
items.summary_zh: 在线空间已沦为由商业化、骚扰和监控驱动的掠夺性环境。文章主张加强平台责任与更安全的设计，以遏制这种动态。

items.title_en: Claude Session URL appended to commit messages and PR descriptions by default
items.title_zh: Claude 会话 URL 默认附加到提交信息和 PR 描述
items.summary_en: A default behavior in Claude code tools automatically appends the session URL to commit messages and pull request descriptions. This poses potential privacy leakage risks, and maintainers may need to disable or patch the feature.
items.summary_zh: Claude 相关工具默认会将会话 URL 附加到提交信息与 PR 描述中，存在隐私泄露风险。维护者可能需要禁用或修补此功能。

items.title_en: Coordination Headwind: How Organizations Are Like Slime Molds
items.title_zh: 协调风暴：组织为何像黏菌
items.summary_en: The piece argues that organizations resemble slime molds in how they coordinate: decentralized, adaptive, and efficient under changing conditions. It highlights implications for organizational design, workflows, and tech teams seeking resilient collaboration.
items.summary_zh: 文章将组织协调比作黏菌，强调去中心化、适应性强且在变化环境中高效运作。为组织设计、工作流和技术团队的协作韧性提供启示。

items.title_en: Continuous Diffusion Language Models (CDLM's)
items.title_zh: 连续扩散语言模型（CDLM）
items.summary_en: Outlines the idea of Continuous Diffusion Language Models, proposing a model that blends diffusion-based generation with language tasks for improved controllability and editability. It discusses potential architectures, challenges, and how CDLMs could complement traditional transformers.
items.summary_zh: 介绍连续扩散语言模型的概念，提出将扩散式生成与语言任务结合，以提升可控性和可编辑性。讨论潜在的架构、挑战，以及 CDLMs 如何与传统 Transformer 互补。

items.title_en: DHS is using obscure law to snoop on journalists, non-profits, unions
items.title_zh: DHS 利用冷门法律监视记者、非营利组织与工会
items.summary_en: New reporting shows DHS used an obscure summons power to obtain data on journalists, nonprofits, and unions, widening concerns about civil-liberties protections and government overreach. The piece underscores the chilling effect on press and civil-society work and calls for greater transparency and reform.
items.summary_zh: 最新报道揭示国土安全部利用一项冷门的传唤权调取记者、非营利组织和工会的数据，扩大了对公民自由与政府越权的担忧。该事件凸显对媒体与民间社会工作的震慑效应，并呼吁提高透明度与推进改革。

items.title_en: The world may have less time than it thinks on climate change
items.title_zh: 气候变化的紧迫时间可能比想象的更短
items.summary_en: The piece argues that the window to avert dangerous climate change may be narrower than many expect, driven by accelerating feedbacks and higher emissions than anticipated. It outlines implications for policy, technology, and finance in meeting climate goals.
items.summary_zh: 文章认为避免危险变暖的时间窗可能比许多人预期的更窄，受加速的反馈机制和高于预期的排放推动。它讨论在实现气候目标方面的政策、技术与资金方面的影响。

items.title_en: Arbitrary code execution in QubesOS via copy-to-VM error reporting backchannel
items.title_zh: QubesOS 拷贝到 VM 错误报告回传通道可实现任意代码执行
items.summary_en: A security disclosure shows a backchannel in Qubes OS’ copy-to-VM error reporting that can be abused to execute arbitrary code inside a target VM. The fix tightens isolation guarantees and reminds users to apply updates to preserve containment boundaries.
items.summary_zh: 安全披露显示 Qubes OS 的拷贝到 VM 的错误报告回传通道可被利用来在目标 VM 内执行任意代码。修复加强了隔离性，并提醒用户及时更新以维持封装边界。

items.title_en: Cores in space: The core memory module from a 1980 Spacelab computer
items.title_zh: 太空中的核心记忆：来自 1980 年 Spacelab 计算机的核心内存模块
items.summary_en: Explores a magnetic core memory module recovered from a 1980 Spacelab computer, illustrating how early memory technology worked and why it mattered for aerospace reliability. The piece connects vintage hardware to contemporary memory concepts, highlighting lessons in durability and engineering trade-offs.
items.summary_zh: 讲述从 1980 年 Spacelab 计算机中回收的核心内存模块，展示早期内存技术的工作原理及其在航天领域的可靠性作用。文章将老派硬件与现代内存概念联系起来，强调耐用性和工程取舍的经验。

items.title_en: Why open source rocks – a new SM750 (Silicon Motion GPU) HDMI Driver
items.title_zh: 开源为何很给力——新款 SM750 GPU 的 HDMI 驱动
items.summary_en: A new open-source HDMI driver for the SM750 GPU demonstrates how community-driven software can extend legacy hardware. It improves compatibility with modern Linux stacks and makes customization easier for hobbyists and device manufacturers.
items.summary_zh: 为 SM750 GPU 推出的开源 HDMI 驱动展示了社区驱动的软件如何延长旧硬件的生命。它提升了与现代内核的兼容性，并为爱好者和设备厂商带来更多定制空间。

items.title_en: Hy4 preview
items.title_zh: 腾讯发布并开源 Hy4 预览版
items.summary_en: Hy4 is Tencent's next large AI model with preview release and open-sourced components, expanding access to its latest AI stack. The move strengthens Tencent's position in the AI race and contributes to the broader open-source ecosystem, particularly for Chinese-language models and multimodal capabilities.
items.summary_zh: 腾讯发布了 Hy4 预览版并开源了核心组件，扩大了对其最新 AI 技术栈的接入。此举提升了腾讯在 AI 竞争中的地位，并为开放源生态做出贡献，特别是在中文模型与多模态能力方面。

items.title_en: Longest Straight Line Paths on Water or Land on the Earth (2018)
items.title_zh: 地球表面水域或陆地上的最长直线路径（2018）
items.summary_en: A geographic study analyzes the longest straight-line routes that can run entirely over water or land on Earth, revealing how coastlines and geography constrain such paths. The findings illuminate interesting quirks in global layouts and have implications for navigational puzzles and geodesic research.
items.summary_zh: 这一地理研究探讨在地球上完全在水域或陆地上绘制的最长直线路线，揭示海岸线和地形如何对路径造成约束。研究结果揭示全球地形的有趣特性，并对导航谜题和测地线研究具有启示意义。

items.title_en: The Rise and Fall of Agent Civilizations
items.title_zh: 代理文明的兴衰
items.summary_en: An exploration of AI agent ecosystems and the dynamics by which multiple agents could form 'civilizations'—with attention to collaboration, competition, and potential collapse. It highlights strategic, safety, and governance challenges as AI agents multiply.
items.summary_zh: 探讨 AI 代理人生态系统及其多代理协作形成“文明”的可能性与动态，关注协作、竞争与潜在崩溃的情景。强调随着代理数量增加，治理、安全与策略的挑战。

items.title_en: Zig: Pointer Stability for ArrayLists
items.title_zh: Zig：ArrayLists 的指针稳定性
items.summary_en: Zig devlog details improvements to ArrayList pointer stability, enabling safer growth without invalidating references and improving performance guarantees for systems code. This work helps Zig approach memory-safety goals while staying close to low-level control.
items.summary_zh: 开发日志介绍了 Zig 在 ArrayList 指针稳定性方面的改进，确保在扩容时不失效引用并提升性能保证。该工作有助于 Zig 在追求内存安全的同时保持对底层控制的灵活性。

items.title_en: Automating Immersive Reading
items.title_zh: 自动化沉浸式阅读
items.summary_en: A piece on automating immersive reading, likely combining text highlights, audio narration, or interactive features to enhance reading engagement, using tooling or browser features.
items.summary_zh: 探讨如何通过自动化工具提升沉浸式阅读体验，结合文本高亮、语音朗读等功能，提升专注度与理解。

items.title_en: FreeCORE TrueNAS Core – Continued
items.title_zh: FreeCORE 继续推进 TrueNAS Core
items.summary_en: FreeCORE continues the TrueNAS Core project, signaling ongoing community-led updates to the NAS OS. The note underscores the resilience of open-source forks and the role of user contributions in sustaining storage-focused platforms.
items.summary_zh: FreeCORE 继续推进 TrueNAS Core 项目，表明社区驱动的 NAS 操作系统仍在持续更新。强调开源分支的韧性，以及用户贡献在维持存储平台中的作用。

items.title_en: Highest-ever ocean temperature measured as powerful El Niño forms
items.title_zh: 在强烈厄尔尼诺形成之际，海洋温度创历史新高
items.summary_en: Record ocean temperatures coincide with a strong El Niño, signaling continued climate system disruption. Warming oceans intensify heatwaves, hurricanes, and marine ecosystem stress, challenging climate models and policy.
items.summary_zh: 海洋表层温度达到历史高位，与强烈厄尔尼诺并发，共同表明全球海洋系统继续承受扰动。海水升温加剧热浪、风暴和海洋生态压力，对气候模型与政策提出更高挑战。

items.title_en: I co-founded Burning Man. The festival has lost its soul
items.title_zh: 我共同创办 Burning Man。这个节日已经失去了灵魂
items.summary_en: From a co-founder's perspective, Burning Man has become over-commercialized and strays from its original communal ethos. The piece reflects on how growth, sponsorship, and enforcement reshape the festival's culture.
items.summary_zh: 从共同创始人的角度，Burning Man 已过度商业化，偏离了最初的社群精神。文中反思增长、赞助与治理如何改变了这个节日的文化。

items.title_en: Defrag98: Windows 98 Disk Defragmenter Simulator Online
items.title_zh: Defrag98：在线的 Windows 98 磁盘碎片整理模拟器
items.summary_en: Defrag98 offers an online Windows 98 disk defragmenter simulator for nostalgia and learning. The tool helps users understand fragmentation concepts and OS internals without old hardware.
items.summary_zh: Defrag98 提供一个在线的 Windows 98 磁盘碎片整理模拟器，便于怀旧与学习。该工具让用户在没有旧硬件的情况下理解碎片化概念与操作系统内部原理。

items.title_en: Functional State Machines in Rust: Typestate and Newtype Patterns
items.title_zh: Rust中的函数式状态机：Typestate与Newtype模式
items.summary_en: Rust’s functional state machines article shows how typestate and newtype patterns can enforce transitions at compile time, preventing illegal state changes. By encoding state into types, you get safer, self-documenting code for protocol handling, parsers, and workflow engines.
items.summary_zh: 文章展示如何用 typestate 与 newtype 模式在 Rust 中实现编译期状态机，防止非法状态转移。通过将状态编码进类型，能为协议处理、解析器和工作流引擎带来更安全、可自文档化的实现。
